summary: Frazier Life Sciences Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company, closed its $75,000,000 IPO of 7,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, with the S-1 declared effective October 13, 2026 and closing October 15, 2026. The sponsor purchased 300,000 private placement shares at $10.00 for $3,000,000, and Frazier Life Sciences Public Fund, L.P. committed to buy at least 2,500,000 shares ($25,000,000) concurrently with the initial business combination. Proceeds sit in a trust with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, and a registration rights agreement grants demand and piggy-back rights. Watch the combination clock, redemptions, and sponsor economics.
